resources.string: Shapes the TLS handshake sent to the edge, making DPI matching harder. Off by default; each mode changes wire bytes.
Split modes require the HTTP/2 carrier. Enable “MASQUE over HTTP/2”; HTTP/3 carries ClientHello in unsplit QUIC frames. Custom SNI works on both.
Shapes TLS ClientHello; WireGuard and WARP×2 do not send one. Choose a MASQUE transport.
Sends a custom name to the MASQUE edge over HTTP/2 or HTTP/3. The pinned certificate prevents interception by a wrong name, but the edge may reject it. Blank uses the default; applies next connect.
